evidence_items.locator: Section 5.1, paragraph discussing the group score
evidence_items.explanation: The group score requires all relevant caption-image comparisons to be correct; every tested model scored below its random baseline. Some models exceeded chance on the less demanding text score, but remained far behind humans and did not reliably solve the complete matching task.

unresolved_gaps: The benchmark does not establish performance for every model available by September 2022.
Image interpretation and cross-modal matching also affect results, so the test does not isolate word-order understanding alone.
